prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1040; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Appraiser's remarks: The rear quarter panel and bumper cover show damage consistent with the impact described by the insured while turning left, and the pattern of deformation lines up with that account. Labor hours on the estimate fit the extent of the damage and the planned repairs, which include panel straightening, replacement of the bumper cover, and refinishing. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from our records. Two similar charges submitted on the same day are under review before the estimate is finalized.
